title: Multi-shot 30-second cinematic sequence, hard cuts as marked.
content:
Multi-shot 30-second cinematic sequence, hard cuts as marked.
Photorealistic 8K, ARRI Alexa large-format character, prime lenses, 35mm grain, professional grade, 180° shutter motion blur, IMAX-scale VFX.
THE WOMAN: late 20s, long dark hair, deep red silk evening dress, barefoot. Calm, unafraid.
THE CREATURE (original design): SHE IS THE CREATURE. Not a separate being. Her own body grows and armors. Obsidian-black interlocking plates sheathing her limbs and torso, molten orange fissures glowing between every plate, elongated arms, a crown of jagged back-swept horns, amber eyes. Human posture and proportions kept, scaled to 90 metres.
TRANSFORMATION PHASES, in strict order:
P1 hairline fractures of orange light open across her skin.
P2 the fissures widen, embers pour upward off her shoulders.
P3 obsidian plates surface through her skin and lock into place, dress burning away into ash.
P4 she grows upward and outward from her own standing body, feet planted, weight driving into the ground, horns pushing through last.
LOCATION: dense modern city, wide granite plaza, glass towers all sides, dusk, empty streets, abandoned cars, streetlights flickering on.
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% cool blue-grey dusk glass and stone / 30% deep shadow / 10% molten orange fissures and embers.
0–4s | SHOT 1 | 24mm wide, low ground-level, slow dolly in. She stands alone centre-plaza, wind moving her hair and dress. City silent.
CUT.
4–7s | SHOT 2 | 100mm macro insert. Her hand and collarbone. First hairline cracks of orange light spread across the skin (P1). No movement otherwise.
CUT.
7–10s | SHOT 3 | 40mm, low behind her, slight dutch. Fissures widen, embers stream upward off her shoulders (P2), granite fracturing in a ring around her bare feet.
CUT.
10–17s | SHOT 4 | THE GROWTH. NO CUT IN THIS SHOT. 35mm, locked on her face at eye level, camera craning upward at exactly her rate of growth so her face stays centre-frame the entire time. Obsidian plates surface and lock across her face and shoulders (P3), amber ignites in her eyes, horns push back through her hair (P4). Her feet never leave the ground. The camera never loses her face.
CUT.
17–21s | SHOT 5 | 21mm worm's-eye, camera on the street between abandoned cars. Her colossal foot plants, buckling the road, cars flipping in the shockwave. Scale reveal.
CUT.
21–25s | SHOT 6 | 50mm aerial, slow helicopter orbit. Full colossus against the skyline, embers and dust swirling, molten light pulsing in her plating.
CUT.
25–28s | SHOT 7 | 85mm, camera mounted on a glass tower facing her. Her arm swings through the facade, curtain wall shearing away in slabs, camera whip-panning down with the falling glass.
CUT.
28–30s | SHOT 8 | 24mm aerial, rising crane pull-back. She stands amid the broken skyline, dust rolling outward, molten fissures pulsing.
PHYSICS: her mass increases continuously, granite fracturing radially from her feet; steel groans and buckles before it fails; glass falls as sheets that shatter on impact; concrete shears in slabs, not crumbs; dust rolls in heavy waves; embers ride heat currents upward.
AUDIO: wind and low city hum, a deep bone-crack as the fissures open, a sustained rising roar through the growth, groaning steel, sheeting glass, thunderous impacts, settling dust.
HARD LOCKS: the creature is the transformed woman, one continuous being. Nothing emerges from the ground. No second creature. She never levitates, floats, or leaves the ground at any moment. Feet planted throughout the transformation. She never vanishes from frame between shots. No people visible anywhere.
FORBIDDEN: no levitation, no separate monster, no ground emergence, no gore or flesh tearing, no franchise creatures, no design drift, no subtitles, no background music, no readable text or logos.

es.content:
Secuencia cinematográfica multishot de 30 segundos, con cortes duros según se indica.
Fotorealista 8K, personaje de formato grande ARRI Alexa, lentes prime, grano 35mm, motion blur profesional con obturador de 180°, VFX a escala IMAX.
LA MUJER: finales de los 20, cabello largo y oscuro, vestido de noche de seda rojo intenso, descalza. Serena, sin miedo.
LA CRIATURA (diseño original): ELLA ES LA CRIATURA. No es un ser aparte. Su propio cuerpo crece y se arma. Placas entrelazadas de obsidiana negra recubren sus extremidades y torso, fisuras de naranja fundido brillando entre cada placa, brazos alargados, una corona de cuernos dentados echados hacia atrás, ojos ámbar. Se mantienen la postura y las proporciones humanas, escalada a 90 metros.
FASES DE TRANSFORMACIÓN, en orden estricto:
P1 se abren finas grietas de luz naranja sobre su piel.
P2 las fisuras se ensanchan, las brasas ascienden desde sus hombros.
P3 placas de obsidiana emergen a través de su piel y se encajan en su lugar, mientras el vestido se consume en cenizas.
P4 crece hacia arriba y hacia afuera desde su propio cuerpo de pie, con los pies plantados, el peso hundiéndose en el suelo, y los cuernos abriéndose paso al final.
UBICACIÓN: ciudad moderna densa, amplia plaza de granito, torres de vidrio por todos lados, atardecer, calles vacías, coches abandonados, farolas encendiéndose parpadeando.
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% vidrio y piedra de un azul grisáceo frío al atardecer / 30% sombra profunda / 10% fisuras y brasas de naranja fundido.
0–4s | TOMA 1 | 24mm gran angular, baja a ras del suelo, slow dolly in. Ella está sola en el centro de la plaza, el viento mueve su cabello y su vestido. La ciudad en silencio.
CORTE.
4–7s | TOMA 2 | inserto macro 100mm. Su mano y clavícula. Las primeras grietas finas de luz naranja se extienden por la piel (P1). Sin movimiento por lo demás.
CORTE.
7–10s | TOMA 3 | 40mm, baja detrás de ella, leve dutch angle. Las fisuras se ensanchan, las brasas ascienden desde sus hombros (P2), el granito se fractura en un anillo alrededor de sus pies descalzos.
CORTE.
10–17s | TOMA 4 | LA CRECIMIENTO. SIN CORTE EN ESTA TOMA. 35mm, encuadrada fija en su rostro a la altura de los ojos, la cámara asciende exactamente a su ritmo de crecimiento para que su rostro permanezca centrado en cuadro todo el tiempo. Las placas de obsidiana emergen y se encajan sobre su rostro y hombros (P3), el ámbar se enciende en sus ojos, los cuernos se abren paso hacia atrás a través de su cabello (P4). Sus pies nunca abandonan el suelo. La cámara nunca pierde su rostro.
CORTE.
17–21s | TOMA 5 | 21mm worm's-eye, cámara en la calle entre coches abandonados. Su pie colosal se planta, deformando la carretera, coches volcándose en la onda expansiva. Revelación de escala.
CORTE.
21–25s | TOMA 6 | 50mm aérea, órbita lenta en helicóptero. El coloso completo contra el skyline, brasas y polvo arremolinándose, luz fundida pulsando en su armadura.
CORTE.
25–28s | TOMA 7 | 85mm, cámara montada en una torre de vidrio frente a ella. Su brazo atraviesa la fachada, la curtain wall se desprende en grandes losas, la cámara hace whip-pan hacia abajo con el vidrio cayendo.
CORTE.
28–30s | TOMA 8 | 24mm aérea, pull-back ascendente de grúa. Ella permanece entre el skyline roto, el polvo extendiéndose hacia afuera, las fisuras fundidas pulsando.
FÍSICA: su masa aumenta de forma continua, el granito se fractura radialmente desde sus pies; el acero gime y se deforma antes de ceder; el vidrio cae en láminas que se hacen añicos al impactar; el hormigón se corta en losas, no en fragmentos; el polvo avanza en olas densas; las brasas ascienden con las corrientes de calor.
AUDIO: viento y un zumbido bajo de la ciudad, un profundo crujido óseo al abrirse las fisuras, un rugido ascendente sostenido durante la transformación, acero gimiendo, vidrio en láminas, impactos atronadores, polvo asentándose.
BLOQUEOS DUROS: la criatura es la mujer transformada, un solo ser continuo. Nada emerge del suelo. No hay una segunda criatura. Nunca levita, flota ni abandona el suelo en ningún momento. Pies plantados durante toda la transformación. Nunca desaparece del encuadre entre tomas. No hay personas visibles en ninguna parte.
PROHIBIDO: sin levitación, sin monstruo separado, sin emergencia desde el suelo, sin gore ni desgarro de carne, sin criaturas de franquicia, sin deriva de diseño, sin subtítulos, sin música de fondo, sin texto legible ni logotipos.

fr.content:
Séquence cinématographique multi-plan de 30 secondes, avec coupes franches aux endroits indiqués.  
Photorealistic 8K, personnage au format large ARRI Alexa, prime lenses, grain 35mm, qualité professionnelle, motion blur 180° shutter, VFX à l’échelle IMAX.  
LA FEMME : fin de vingtaine, longs cheveux bruns, robe de soirée en soie rouge profond, pieds nus. Calme, sans peur.  
LA CRÉATURE (design original) : ELLE EST LA CRÉATURE. Pas un être séparé. Son propre corps s’étend et s’armure. Plaques imbriquées noir obsidienne gainant ses membres et son torse, fissures orange en fusion brillant entre chaque plaque, bras allongés, couronne de cornes dentelées rejetées vers l’arrière, yeux ambrés. Posture et proportions humaines conservées, échelle portée à 90 mètres.  
PHASES DE TRANSFORMATION, dans l’ordre strict :  
P1 de fines fissures de lumière orange s’ouvrent sur sa peau.  
P2 les fissures s’élargissent, des braises s’élèvent de ses épaules.  
P3 des plaques d’obsidienne émergent à travers sa peau et se verrouillent en place, la robe se consumant en cendres.  
P4 elle grandit vers le haut et vers l’extérieur à partir de son propre corps debout, pieds ancrés au sol, son poids s’enfonçant dans la terre, les cornes perçant en dernier.  
LIEU : dense ville moderne, vaste place de granit, tours de verre tout autour, crépuscule, rues désertes, voitures abandonnées, lampadaires qui s’allument par intermittence.  
COULEUR 60:30:10 — 60 % verre et pierre bleu-gris froids du crépuscule / 30 % ombre profonde / 10 % fissures et braises orange en fusion.  
0–4s | PLAN 1 | 24mm grand angle, bas au niveau du sol, lent travelling avant. Elle se tient seule au centre de la place, le vent agitant ses cheveux et sa robe. La ville est silencieuse.  
COUPE.  
4–7s | PLAN 2 | Insert macro 100mm. Sa main et sa clavicule. Les premières fissures fines de lumière orange se répandent sur la peau (P1). Aucun autre mouvement.  
COUPE.  
7–10s | PLAN 3 | 40mm, bas derrière elle, léger dutch angle. Les fissures s’élargissent, des braises montent de ses épaules (P2), le granit se fissure en anneau autour de ses pieds nus.  
COUPE.  
10–17s | PLAN 4 | LA CROISSANCE. AUCUNE COUPE DANS CE PLAN. 35mm, cadré sur son visage à hauteur des yeux, caméra qui monte exactement à sa vitesse de croissance pour que son visage reste au centre du cadre tout du long. Des plaques d’obsidienne émergent et se verrouillent sur son visage et ses épaules (P3), l’ambre s’embrase dans ses yeux, des cornes repoussent à travers ses cheveux (P4). Ses pieds ne quittent jamais le sol. La caméra ne perd jamais son visage.  
COUPE.  
17–21s | PLAN 5 | 21mm contre-plongée extrême, caméra dans la rue entre des voitures abandonnées. Son pied colossal se pose, faisant céder la chaussée, les voitures basculant dans l’onde de choc. Révélation de l’échelle.  
COUPE.  
21–25s | PLAN 6 | Aérien 50mm, lent orbitage en hélicoptère. Colosse en entier sur fond de skyline, braises et poussière tourbillonnant, lumière en fusion pulsant dans son armure.  
COUPE.  
25–28s | PLAN 7 | 85mm, caméra fixée sur une tour de verre face à elle. Son bras traverse la façade, le mur-rideau se détachant en dalles, la caméra effectuant un whip-pan vers le bas avec la chute du verre.  
COUPE.  
28–30s | PLAN 8 | Aérien 24mm, recul ascendant de grue. Elle se tient au milieu de la skyline brisée, la poussière se déployant vers l’extérieur, les fissures en fusion pulsant.  
PHYSIQUE : sa masse augmente continuellement, le granit se fissure radialement à partir de ses pieds ; l’acier gémit et se déforme avant de céder ; le verre tombe en plaques qui se brisent à l’impact ; le béton se cisaille en dalles, pas en miettes ; la poussière roule en vagues épaisses ; les braises remontent dans les courants de chaleur.  
AUDIO : vent et léger bourdonnement urbain, un profond craquement d’os à l’ouverture des fissures, un rugissement soutenu et montant pendant la croissance, acier qui gémit, verre en plaques, impacts tonitruants, poussière qui retombe.  
VERROUILLAGES STRICTS : la créature est la femme transformée, un seul être continu. Rien n’émerge du sol. Aucun second monstre. Elle ne lévite jamais, ne flotte jamais, et ne quitte jamais le sol à aucun moment. Pieds ancrés tout au long de la transformation. Elle ne disparaît jamais du cadre entre les plans. Aucune personne visible nulle part.  
INTERDIT : pas de lévitation, pas de monstre séparé, pas d’émergence depuis le sol, pas de gore ni de chair déchirée, pas de créatures de franchise, pas de dérive de design, pas de sous-titres, pas de musique de fond, pas de texte lisible ni de logos.

マルチショットの30秒シネマティックシーケンス、指定どおりハードカット。
フォトリアルな8K、ARRI Alexaのラージフォーマットキャラクター、プライムレンズ、35mmグレイン、プロフェッショナルグレード、180°シャッターのモーションブラー、IMAXスケールのVFX。
THE WOMAN: 20代後半、長い黒髪、深紅のシルクのイブニングドレス、裸足。落ち着いていて、恐れを知らない。
THE CREATURE (original design): SHE IS THE CREATURE. 別個の存在ではない。彼女自身の身体が成長し、装甲化していく。四肢と胴体を覆う黒曜石のような黒いインターロッキングプレート、各プレートの間に溶融したオレンジの亀裂が発光し、細長い腕、後方へ反り返る鋭い角の王冠、琥珀色の瞳。人間の姿勢とプロポーションは維持しつつ、90メートル規模に拡大。
TRANSFORMATION PHASES, in strict order:
P1 彼女の皮膚全体に、オレンジの光の細い亀裂が走り始める。
P2 亀裂が広がり、肩から熾火が上向きに噴き上がる。
P3 黒曜石のプレートが皮膚を突き破るように現れて固定され、ドレスは燃え尽きて灰になる。
P4 彼女は立ったままの自分の身体から上方かつ外側へ成長し、足は地面に固定されたまま、体重が地面へと押し込まれ、最後に角が押し出される。
LOCATION: 高密度の近代都市、広い花崗岩の広場、四方をガラスの高層ビルに囲まれた夕暮れ、空っぽの通り、放置された車、街灯が点き始めてちらつく。
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% クールな青灰色の夕暮れのガラスと石 / 30% 深い影 / 10% 溶融したオレンジの亀裂と熾火。
0–4s | SHOT 1 | 24mm wide, low ground-level, slow dolly in. 彼女は広場の中央にひとり立ち、風が髪とドレスを揺らす。都市は静寂。
CUT.
4–7s | SHOT 2 | 100mm macro insert. 彼女の手と鎖骨。オレンジの光の最初の細い亀裂が皮膚に広がる（P1）。それ以外の動きはない。
CUT.
7–10s | SHOT 3 | 40mm, low behind her, slight dutch. 亀裂が広がり、肩から熾火が上向きに流れ出す（P2）。裸足の周囲の花崗岩が輪状にひび割れる。
CUT.
10–17s | SHOT 4 | THE GROWTH. NO CUT IN THIS SHOT. 35mm, locked on her face at eye level, camera craning upward at exactly her rate of growth so her face stays centre-frame the entire time. 黒曜石のプレートが顔と肩に現れて固定され（P3）、瞳に琥珀色の光が宿り、角が髪を押し分けて後方へ伸びる（P4）。彼女の足は決して地面を離れない。カメラは最後まで彼女の顔を見失わない。
CUT.
17–21s | SHOT 5 | 21mm worm's-eye, camera on the street between abandoned cars. 彼女の巨大な足が着地し、道路がたわみ、衝撃波で車がひっくり返る。スケールの露呈。
CUT.
21–25s | SHOT 6 | 50mm aerial, slow helicopter orbit. スカイラインを背にした全身の巨像、熾火と塵が渦を巻き、彼女の装甲に溶融光が脈打つ。
CUT.
25–28s | SHOT 7 | 85mm, camera mounted on a glass tower facing her. 彼女の腕がファサードを突き抜け、カーテンウォールが大きな板状に剥がれ落ち、カメラは落下するガラスに合わせて急激にパンダウンする。
CUT.
28–30s | SHOT 8 | 24mm aerial, rising crane pull-back. 彼女は壊れたスカイラインの中に立ち、塵が外側へと流れ、溶融した亀裂が脈打つ。
PHYSICS: 彼女の質量は連続的に増加し、花崗岩は足元から放射状にひび割れる。鋼材は破断する前にうなり、たわむ。ガラスは板状に落下し、衝撃で砕ける。コンクリートは粉々ではなく、塊としてせん断される。塵は重い波となって流れ、熾火は熱対流に乗って上昇する。
AUDIO: 風と低い都市のハム音、亀裂が開くときの深い骨の軋み、成長に伴う持続的に高まる咆哮、うなる鋼材、板状に割れるガラス、雷鳴のような衝突音、沈降する塵。
HARD LOCKS: the creature is the transformed woman, one continuous being. Nothing emerges from the ground. No second creature. She never levitates, floats, or leaves the ground at any moment. Feet planted throughout the transformation. She never vanishes from frame between shots. No people visible anywhere.
FORBIDDEN: no levitation, no separate monster, no ground emergence, no gore or flesh tearing, no franchise creatures, no design drift, no subtitles, no background music, no readable text or logos.

グレイン、プロフェッショナルグレード、180°シャッターのモーションブラー、IMAXスケールのVFX。
THE WOMAN: 20代後半、長い黒髪、深紅のシルクのイブニングドレス、
裸足。落ち着いていて、恐れを知らない。
THE CREATURE (original design): SHE IS THE CREATURE. 別個の
存在ではない。彼女自身の身体が成長し、装甲化していく。黒曜石のような黒いインターロッキングプレートが
四肢と胴体を覆い、各プレートの間に溶融したオレンジの亀裂が発光し、
細長い腕、後方へ反り返る鋭い角の王冠、琥珀色の瞳。人間の姿勢とプロポーションは維持しつつ、90メートル規模に拡大。
TRANSFORMATION PHASES, in strict order:
P1 彼女の皮膚全体に、オレンジの光の細い亀裂が走り始める。
P2 亀裂が広がり、肩から熾火が上向きに噴き上がる。
P3 黒曜石のプレートが皮膚を突き破るように現れて固定され、ドレス
は燃え尽きて灰になる。
P4 彼女は立ったままの自分の身体から上方かつ外側へ成長し、足は地面に固定されたまま、
体重が地面へと押し込まれ、最後に角が押し出される。
LOCATION: 高密度の近代都市、広い花崗岩の広場、四方をガラスの高層ビルに囲まれた夕暮れ、空っぽの通り、放置された車、街灯が点き始めてちらつく。
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% クールな青灰

ko.content:
멀티샷 30초 시네마틱 시퀀스, 표시된 대로 하드 컷.
Photorealistic 8K, ARRI Alexa large-format character, prime lenses, 35mm grain, professional grade, 180° shutter motion blur, IMAX-scale VFX.
THE WOMAN: late 20s, long dark hair, deep red silk evening dress, barefoot. Calm, unafraid.
THE CREATURE (original design): SHE IS THE CREATURE. Not a separate being. Her own body grows and armors. Obsidian-black interlocking plates sheathing her limbs and torso, molten orange fissures glowing between every plate, elongated arms, a crown of jagged back-swept horns, amber eyes. Human posture and proportions kept, scaled to 90 metres.
TRANSFORMATION PHASES, in strict order:
P1 hairline fractures of orange light open across her skin.
P2 the fissures widen, embers pour upward off her shoulders.
P3 obsidian plates surface through her skin and lock into place, dress burning away into ash.
P4 she grows upward and outward from her own standing body, feet planted, weight driving into the ground, horns pushing through last.
LOCATION: dense modern city, wide granite plaza, glass towers all sides, dusk, empty streets, abandoned cars, streetlights flickering on.
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% cool blue-grey dusk glass and stone / 30% deep shadow / 10% molten orange fissures and embers.
0–4s | SHOT 1 | 24mm wide, low ground-level, slow dolly in. She stands alone centre-plaza, wind moving her hair and dress. City silent.
CUT.
4–7s | SHOT 2 | 100mm macro insert. Her hand and collarbone. First hairline cracks of orange light spread across the skin (P1). No movement otherwise.
CUT.
7–10s | SHOT 3 | 40mm, low behind her, slight dutch. Fissures widen, embers stream upward off her shoulders (P2), granite fracturing in a ring around her bare feet.
CUT.
10–17s | SHOT 4 | THE GROWTH. NO CUT IN THIS SHOT. 35mm, locked on her face at eye level, camera craning upward at exactly her rate of growth so her face stays centre-frame the entire time. Obsidian plates surface and lock across her face and shoulders (P3), amber ignites in her eyes, horns push back through her hair (P4). Her feet never leave the ground. The camera never loses her face.
CUT.
17–21s | SHOT 5 | 21mm worm's-eye, camera on the street between abandoned cars. Her colossal foot plants, buckling the road, cars flipping in the shockwave. Scale reveal.
CUT.
21–25s | SHOT 6 | 50mm aerial, slow helicopter orbit. Full colossus against the skyline, embers and dust swirling, molten light pulsing in her plating.
CUT.
25–28s | SHOT 7 | 85mm, camera mounted on a glass tower facing her. Her arm swings through the facade, curtain wall shearing away in slabs, camera whip-panning down with the falling glass.
CUT.
28–30s | SHOT 8 | 24mm aerial, rising crane pull-back. She stands amid the broken skyline, dust rolling outward, molten fissures pulsing.
PHYSICS: her mass increases continuously, granite fracturing radially from her feet; steel groans and buckles before it fails; glass falls as sheets that shatter on impact; concrete shears in slabs, not crumbs; dust rolls in heavy waves; embers ride heat currents upward.
AUDIO: wind and low city hum, a deep bone-crack as the fissures open, a sustained rising roar through the growth, groaning steel, sheeting glass, thunderous impacts, settling dust.
HARD LOCKS: the creature is the transformed woman, one continuous being. Nothing emerges from the ground. No second creature. She never levitates, floats, or leaves the ground at any moment. Feet planted throughout the transformation. She never vanishes from frame between shots. No people visible anywhere.
FORBIDDEN: no levitation, no separate monster, no ground emergence, no gore or flesh tearing, no franchise creatures, no design drift, no subtitles, no background music, no readable text or logos.

Sequência cinematográfica de 30 segundos em múltiplos planos, cortes secos conforme indicado.
Fotorealista em 8K, personagem em formato grande da ARRI Alexa, lentes prime, granulação 35mm, padrão profissional, motion blur de obturador em 180°, VFX em escala IMAX.
A MULHER: final dos 20 anos, cabelo longo escuro, vestido de seda vermelho-escuro de noite, descalça. Calma, sem medo.
A CRIATURA (design original): ELA É A CRIATURA. Não é um ser separado. O próprio corpo dela cresce e se arma. Placas interligadas preto-obsidiana revestindo os membros e o torso, fissuras laranja incandescente brilhando entre cada placa, braços alongados, uma coroa de chifres irregulares inclinados para trás, olhos âmbar. Postura e proporções humanas mantidas, ampliada para 90 metros.
FASES DA TRANSFORMAÇÃO, em ordem estrita:
P1 fissuras finas de luz laranja se abrem pela pele.
P2 as fissuras se alargam, brasas sobem das suas costas.
P3 placas de obsidiana emergem através da pele e se travam no lugar, o vestido queimando até virar cinzas.
P4 ela cresce para cima e para fora a partir do próprio corpo em pé, pés plantados, o peso se cravando no chão, chifres surgindo por último.
LOCALIZAÇÃO: cidade moderna densa, ampla praça de granito, torres de vidro em todos os lados, entardecer, ruas vazias, carros abandonados, postes de luz acendendo e piscando.
COR 60:30:10 — 60% vidro e pedra em azul-cinza frio do entardecer / 30% sombra profunda / 10% fissuras e brasas laranja incandescentes.
0–4s | PLANO 1 | 24mm wide, low ground-level, slow dolly in. Ela está sozinha no centro da praça, o vento movendo seu cabelo e vestido. Cidade silenciosa.
CORTE.
4–7s | PLANO 2 | 100mm macro insert. Sua mão e clavícula. As primeiras fissuras finas de luz laranja se espalham pela pele (P1). Sem outro movimento.
CORTE.
7–10s | PLANO 3 | 40mm, low behind her, slight dutch. As fissuras se alargam, brasas sobem das suas costas (P2), o granito se fraturando em um anel ao redor dos seus pés descalços.
CORTE.
10–17s | PLANO 4 | THE GROWTH. NO CUT IN THIS SHOT. 35mm, locked on her face at eye level, camera craning upward at exactly her rate of growth so her face stays centre-frame the entire time. Obsidian plates surface and lock across her face and shoulders (P3), amber ignites in her eyes, horns push back through her hair (P4). Her feet never leave the ground. The camera never loses her face.
CORTE.
17–21s | PLANO 5 | 21mm worm's-eye, camera on the street between abandoned cars. Her colossal foot plants, buckling the road, cars flipping in the shockwave. Scale reveal.
CORTE.
21–25s | PLANO 6 | 50mm aerial, slow helicopter orbit. Full colossus against the skyline, embers and dust swirling, molten light pulsing in her plating.
CORTE.
25–28s | PLANO 7 | 85mm, camera mounted on a glass tower facing her. Her arm swings through the facade, curtain wall shearing away in slabs, camera whip-panning down with the falling glass.
CORTE.
28–30s | PLANO 8 | 24mm aerial, rising crane pull-back. She stands amid the broken skyline, dust rolling outward, molten fissures pulsing.
FÍSICA: sua massa aumenta continuamente, o granito se fratura radialmente a partir dos seus pés; o aço geme e entorta antes de falhar; o vidro cai em placas que se estilhaçam no impacto; o concreto se parte em lajes, não em fragmentos; a poeira se espalha em ondas pesadas; as brasas sobem nas correntes de calor.
ÁUDIO: vento e um baixo zumbido urbano, um profundo estalo de ossos quando as fissuras se abrem, um rugido crescente e sustentado durante a transformação, aço rangendo, vidro em placas, impactos estrondosos, poeira assentando.
TRAVAS RÍGIDAS: a criatura é a mulher transformada, um único ser contínuo. Nada emerge do chão. Nenhuma segunda criatura. Ela nunca levita, flutua ou deixa o chão em momento algum. Pés plantados durante toda a transformação. Ela nunca some do quadro entre os planos. Nenhuma pessoa visível em lugar nenhum.
PROIBIDO: sem levitação, sem monstro separado, sem emergência do chão, sem gore ou rasgar de carne, sem criaturas de franquia, sem desvio de design, sem legendas, sem música de fundo, sem texto legível ou logotipos.

zh.content:
多镜头 30 秒电影感序列，按标注硬切。
写实 8K，ARRI Alexa 大画幅角色，定焦镜头，35mm 胶片颗粒，专业级，180° 快门运动模糊，IMAX 级 VFX。
THE WOMAN：20 多岁末，长黑发，深红色丝绸晚礼服，赤脚。冷静、无所畏惧。
THE CREATURE（原创设计）：她就是这个生物。不是另一个独立存在。她自己的身体生长并披覆装甲。黑曜石般的黑色互锁甲片包裹四肢与躯干，甲片之间有熔融橙色裂隙发光，手臂修长，背向后延展的锯齿状犄角冠，琥珀色眼睛。保留人类的姿态与比例，放大到 90 米。
TRANSFORMATION PHASES，严格按顺序：
P1 橙色光的细微裂纹在她皮肤上张开。
P2 裂隙扩大，余烬从她肩头向上喷涌。
P3 黑曜石甲片从皮肤下浮现并锁定成形，礼服燃尽成灰。
P4 她从自己站立的身体向上、向外生长，双脚钉在地面，重量压入地面，最后犄角穿出。
LOCATION：密集现代城市，宽阔花岗岩广场，四周玻璃高楼，黄昏，空无一人的街道，废弃车辆，路灯开始闪亮。
COLOR 60:30:10 — 60% 冷蓝灰色黄昏玻璃与石材 / 30% 深阴影 / 10% 熔融橙色裂隙与余烬。
0–4s | SHOT 1 | 24mm 广角，低机位贴近地面，缓慢推入。她独自站在广场中央，风吹动她的头发和裙摆。城市寂静。
CUT.
4–7s | SHOT 2 | 100mm 微距插入。她的手和锁骨。第一道橙色细裂光纹在皮肤上蔓延（P1）。除此之外没有任何动作。
CUT.
7–10s | SHOT 3 | 40mm，从她身后低位拍摄，轻微 Dutch angle。裂隙扩大，余烬从肩头向上流动（P2），花岗岩在她赤脚周围呈环状开裂。
CUT.
10–17s | SHOT 4 | THE GROWTH. NO CUT IN THIS SHOT. 35mm，锁定她的脸部，平视机位，摄影机以与她生长完全一致的速度向上升起，使她的脸始终保持在画面中央。黑曜石甲片从她脸部与肩部表面浮现并锁定（P3），琥珀色在她眼中点燃，犄角穿过头发向后顶出（P4）。她的双脚始终没有离开地面。摄影机始终不丢失她的脸。
CUT.
17–21s | SHOT 5 | 21mm 蛇眼视角，摄影机位于废弃车辆之间的街道上。她巨大的脚落下，路面塌陷，车辆在冲击波中翻飞。尺度揭示。
CUT.
21–25s | SHOT 6 | 50mm 航拍，缓慢直升机环绕。巨像全身映衬天际线，余烬与尘土盘旋，熔融光芒在她的装甲中脉动。
CUT.
25–28s | SHOT 7 | 85mm，摄影机安装在一座玻璃塔楼上，正对着她。她的手臂扫过立面，幕墙成整块剥离，摄影机随坠落的玻璃快速摇移向下。
CUT.
28–30s | SHOT 8 | 24mm 航拍，升高的吊臂后拉。她站在破碎的天际线之间，尘土向外翻卷，熔融裂隙脉动。
PHYSICS：她的质量持续增加，花岗岩从她脚下向外放射状开裂；钢结构在失效前先发出呻吟并弯折；玻璃以整片形式坠落并在撞击时碎裂；混凝土以板块状剪裂，而不是碎成渣；尘土以厚重波浪翻滚；余烬沿热气流向上升腾。
AUDIO：风声与低沉的城市嗡鸣，裂隙张开时一声深沉的骨裂声，生长过程中持续上升的咆哮，钢铁呻吟，玻璃成片坠落，雷鸣般的撞击，尘埃沉降。
HARD LOCKS：这个生物就是被转化后的女人，是一个连续的存在。没有任何东西从地面冒出。没有第二个生物。她在任何时刻都不会悬浮、漂浮或离开地面。整个变形过程中双脚始终钉在地面上。镜头之间她从未从画面中消失。任何地方都看不到人。
FORBIDDEN：不要悬浮，不要独立怪物，不要从地面出现，不要血腥或撕裂皮肉，不要系列作品中的生物，不要设计偏移，不要字幕，不要背景音乐，不要可读文字或 logo。
